prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Choose Path Grid Selection Redesign: Rebuild the path options section on the choose_path screen into a clean grid layout with distinct choice cards for each pet selection path.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "grid", "replace": {"path_options": [{"type": "choice_cards", "role": "path_options", "style": "rounded"}]}}}
1: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Quick Selection Tip: Add a quick hint below the story screen header reassuring users that their path choice can be changed later anytime.
   config: {"story": {"hint": "Don't worry, you can always adopt additional pets or change paths later in settings."}}
2: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Simplified Centered Layout: Redesign the sign_in screen to use a centered layout with prominent sign-in options and clear account safety messaging.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Companion", "replace": {"sign_in_options": [{"type": "button", "role": "sign_in_options", "label": "Sign In with Account", "style": "emphasis"}]}}}
3: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Desktop Background Notification: Enable a system notification on the waiting screen to alert users when their desktop pet finished generating while minimized.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Preparing Your Desktop Companion", "body": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"}}
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Tip Carousel: Add an auto-rotating tip carousel component to the waiting screen sharing basic tips on pet controls and desktop behavior.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open quick controls and settings.", "style": "subtle"}]}}
5: [adoption, incentive] Pick Friend Selection Reward Incentive: Display a clear badge component highlighting complimentary companion starter items upon picking a pet friend.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Includes Starter Accessory Pack", "style": "playful"}]}}
6: [adoption, copy] Photo Upload Friendly Guidance Header: Update headline and body on the upload_photos screen to clearly explain photo quality needs and prevent generation errors.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Clear Pet Photos", "body": "Use well-lit photos showing your pet's face clearly for the best desktop pet creation result.", "hint": "Front-facing photos with clear lighting work best."}}
7: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Full Bleed Stage Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a full bleed layout with an interactive pet preview component.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "full_bleed", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_preview", "style": "large"}]}}
8: [choose_path, new_screen] Choose Path Guided Intro New Screen: Add a new introductory screen before choose_path to explain how desktop pets live on the user's screen.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_path_intro", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Journey"}}
9: [finish, hint] Home Intro Pet Desktop Visibility Hint: Add an explicit hint text on home_intro explaining how to summon or show the pet if it hides off-screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "If your pet wanders off-screen, click the system tray icon to recall it immediately."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the path options on choose_path into a grid layout while preserving all required screen functions.
Adds a helpful hint to the story screen without violating onboarding copy rules.
Redesigns the sign-in screen layout while retaining sign-in options.
Adds a desktop notification setting to the waiting screen within onboarding rules.
Adds a tip carousel to the waiting screen without introducing false urgency or modifying pricing.
Onboarding copy mentions free extras or starter items ('Includes Starter Accessory Pack'), which violates the rule against mentioning gifts or extras.
Updates guidance copy on the photo upload screen without removing required functionality.
Redesigning the adoption certificate components to only include a preview removes the official stamp required for the adoption certificate screen.
Adds a new introductory screen before choose_path without removing or skipping any required onboarding steps.
Adds a helpful visibility hint to home_intro without modifying elements outside of onboarding.
